full_judgment: This Rule is directed against the order dated 2-3-94 passed in OC Suit No. 33 of 1989 by the lst Court of Additional Sessions Judge, Tangail rejecting the application under Order 7 rule II (a)CPC for rejection of plaint. In a suit for cancellation of the decree passed in a partition suit the defendant petitioner filed ail' application for rejection of the plaint under Order 7 rule 11(a) CPC on 21-4-93. The learned Assistant Judge by the impugned order rejected the prayer. Being aggrieved the defendant moved this court and obtained the Rule.
